blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – Unable to sleep at night because of the loud noise from passing motorcycles with modified mufflers? The local government of Cordova has announced an intensified campaign against motorists using modified mufflers that produce excessive noise and disturb nearby residents.
